summary: Strive, Inc. filed an Item 8.01 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing open-market bitcoin purchases of 469 BTC between September 8 and September 11, 2026, at an average price of approximately $77,954 per bitcoin inclusive of fees. The filing also updates holdings: cash of $204.2 million, 25,000 bitcoin, and 505,000 STRC preferred shares valued at $49.8 million, plus 94.97 million effective common shares and 10.40 million SATA preferred shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms are stated; this is a routine treasury and holdings disclosure, not a special situation.
